SELECT c.id, c.campus_id AS campusId, cp.name AS campusName, c.name, c.phone, c.child_name AS childName, c.sex, c.parent_name AS parentName, c.mother_tel AS motherTel, c.father_tel AS fatherTel, c.other_tel AS otherTel, c.source, c.channel, c.scene, c.method, c.salesway, c.salesman_name AS salesmanName, c.status, c.follow_state_text AS followStateText, c.enrolled, c.interest, c.intention_course AS intentionCourse, c.school_name AS schoolName, c.grade, c.pub_school AS pubSchool, c.home_address AS homeAddress, c.birthday, c.arrearage, c.remain_lessons AS remainLessons, c.remark, c.content, c.next_follow_at AS nextFollowAt, c.last_follow_at AS lastFollowAt, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM consult c LEFT JOIN campus cp ON cp.id = c.campus_id
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(c.enrolled = 1), 0) AS enrolled, COALESCE(SUM(c.enrolled = 0), 0) AS following, COALESCE(SUM(c.created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')), 0) AS thisMonth, COUNT(DISTINCT c.phone) AS phoneCount FROM consult c

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(c.source, ''), '未知来源') AS source, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(c.enrolled = 1), 0) AS enrolled FROM consult c
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(c.source, ''), '未知来源') ORDER BY count DESC
